grimer-minimize.name: Minimize
grimer-minimize.description: Bond skill: shrinks its sludgy body to a puddle, becoming Fortified for 3 turns.

grimer-gunk-shot.name: Gunk Shot
grimer-gunk-shot.description: Bond skill: hurls filthy garbage at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 100, Attack), Poisoning 3 turns.

grimer-sludge-bomb.name: Sludge Bomb
grimer-sludge-bomb.description: Bond skill: lobs sludge up to 2 hexes away (Power 90, Sp. Atk) hitting a 1-hex area.

grimer-poison-touch.name: Poison Touch
grimer-poison-touch.description: Its hits on adjacent foes deal 10% more and Poison them for 2 turns.

grimer-amorphous-body.name: Amorphous Body
grimer-amorphous-body.description: Takes 10% less damage: blows sink into its sludge.

grimer-disable.name: Disable
grimer-disable.description: New skill: seals a foe up to 2 hexes away; Disabled (basic attack only) for 2 turns.

grimer-shed-skin.name: Shed Skin
grimer-shed-skin.description: Sheds statuses foes put on it at the start of its turn.

grimer-lingering-toxins.name: Lingering Toxins
grimer-lingering-toxins.description: Statuses it inflicts last 1 more turn; deals 15% more to foes carrying a status an ally applied.

grimer-screech.name: Screech
grimer-screech.description: New skill: an awful screech Exposes a foe up to 2 hexes away for 2 turns.

grimer-gooey-grip.name: Gooey Grip
grimer-gooey-grip.description: Foes engaged with it always draw its free strike when stepping away.

grimer-toxic-hunger.name: Toxic Hunger
grimer-toxic-hunger.description: Deals 20% more damage to Poisoned foes.

grimer-sludge-wave.name: Sludge Wave
grimer-sludge-wave.description: New skill: a wave of sludge hits every adjacent foe (Power 85), Poisoning them for 1 turn.

grimer-poison-jab.name: Poison Jab
grimer-poison-jab.description: New skill: jabs with a toxic, sludgy arm (Power 85), Poisoning the foe for 2 turns.

grimer-stench-cloud.name: Stench
grimer-stench-cloud.description: Deals 10% more damage; when a foe it afflicted faints, adjacent foes catch that status.

grimer-ooze-regrowth.name: Ooze Regrowth
grimer-ooze-regrowth.description: Heals 5% of max HP at the start of each turn.

grimer-sludge-feast.name: Sludge Feast
grimer-sludge-feast.description: Heals 15% of max HP when it knocks out a foe.

grimer-toxic-shroud.name: Toxic Shroud
grimer-toxic-shroud.description: Deals 15% more damage to foes carrying any status.

grimer-living-sludge.name: Living Sludge
grimer-living-sludge.description: Capstone. Takes 15% less damage; heals 3% of max HP each turn while engaged.

grimer-toxic-monarch.name: Toxic Monarch
grimer-toxic-monarch.description: Capstone. Its Poison moves deal 25% more; foes it engages take 20% more from its allies.

grimer-acid-spray.name: Acid Spray
grimer-acid-spray.description: New skill: sprays acid at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 45), Marking it for 1 turn.

grimer-wrap.name: Wrap
grimer-wrap.description: New skill: wraps an adjacent foe in sludge (Power 45), engaging it; Slow 1 turn.

grimer-body-slam.name: Body Slam
grimer-body-slam.description: New skill: flops its sludgy bulk onto a foe (Power 90), Paralyzing it for 1 turn.

grimer-belch.name: Belch
grimer-belch.description: New skill: a foul belch at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 95).
